name: SWE-bench task corpus
source_unit: GitHub issues, base commits, and resolving pull requests
synthesis_or_collection: Extract issue–PR pairs and reconstruct their repository environments
verifier: FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS tests
main_limit: Public patches are vulnerable to contamination, and collection retains only tasks with reconstructable histories

name: SWE-smith
source_unit: Installable Python repositories, tests, and code mutations
synthesis_or_collection: Build each repository environment, inject a bug that breaks existing tests, then generate an issue and trajectories
verifier: Existing-test fail-to-pass behavior and environment executability
main_limit: Synthetic bugs may be overly local, and the test suite determines the boundary of what can be verified

name: SWE-rebench V2
source_unit: Recent multilingual GitHub pull requests, repository setup, and candidate tests
synthesis_or_collection: Continuously collect pull requests, generate repository-specific setup, and combine execution filtering with judge ensembles
verifier: Container execution, test differentials, and judge ensembles
main_limit: A changing distribution weakens cross-version comparability, while automated setup and judging may introduce selection bias

name: CyberGym environments
source_unit: Historical vulnerabilities, vulnerable and fixed versions, and proof-of-concept exploits
synthesis_or_collection: Automatically construct pre- and post-patch vulnerability-reproduction environments
verifier: Crash before the patch and no crash after the patch
main_limit: Licensing, build failures, and dangerous code require strict isolation and human audit

name: MLE-bench competition packages
source_unit: Kaggle competition data, descriptions, and metrics
synthesis_or_collection: Reconstruct real competitions as isolated agent workspaces
verifier: Competition metrics and medal thresholds
main_limit: Data licenses and compute differences limit reuse, and leaderboard priors may contaminate evaluation

name: PaperBench reproduction packages
source_unit: Papers, code, author rubrics, and environments
synthesis_or_collection: Paper authors decompose reproduction goals into hierarchical outcomes and construct fresh runs
verifier: Hierarchical rubrics, JudgeEval, and independent reruns
main_limit: Author decomposition is expensive, and both open-ended judges and reproduction infrastructure require maintenance

name: Mind2Web
source_unit: Real website tasks, actions, DOM snapshots, and screenshots
synthesis_or_collection: Crowd workers complete tasks on real websites while their actions are recorded
verifier: Offline action matching and element-grounding metrics
main_limit: Offline trajectories do not establish execution outcomes, and websites and DOM structures age quickly

name: WebLINX
source_unit: User–assistant dialogue, web actions, HTML, and screenshots
synthesis_or_collection: Record multiturn browsing trajectories in realistic collaborative scenarios
verifier: Offline action, element, and text metrics
main_limit: Data favor happy paths and lack resettable online state, while offline grading struggles with tasks that admit multiple solutions

name: τ²-bench task blueprints
source_unit: Policies, initial states, dual-control actions, and goal states
synthesis_or_collection: Compose tasks from atomic components and unfold user–agent interaction
verifier: Terminal-state, communication, and policy assertions
main_limit: Combinatorial scale can overstate genuine diversity, and the simulator defines the user behavior distribution

name: WorkArena++ compositional generator
source_unit: ServiceNow atomic tasks, initial-state configurations, and composition rules
synthesis_or_collection: Compose atomic tasks while jointly generating setup, oracle traces, and validation
verifier: Programmatic terminal-state validation
main_limit: The generator is constrained by one SaaS platform and a hand-authored workflow grammar

name: LegalAgentBench construction pipeline
source_unit: Seventeen legal corpora, 37 tools, and a planning tree
synthesis_or_collection: Sample multihop and writing tasks from tool dependencies and difficulty conditions
verifier: Answer keywords and process progress rate
main_limit: Keyword verifiers miss equivalent arguments, and legal jurisdiction and temporal validity are limited

name: AgentTrek
source_unit: Web tutorials, demonstration steps, and browser state
synthesis_or_collection: Extract tasks from tutorials and synthesize agent trajectories through guided replay
verifier: Vision/model critics and replay consistency
main_limit: Tutorials favor standard paths, and critics may miss hidden business errors or side effects

name: APIGen
source_unit: API documentation, function schemas, generated requests, and calls
synthesis_or_collection: Generate candidates and filter them in format, execution, and semantic stages
verifier: Schema checks, real execution, and semantic verification
main_limit: Validates API calls rather than domain policy or persistent state, and live services can drift

name: APIGen-MT
source_unit: Task blueprints with ground-truth actions and simulated human and agent roles
synthesis_or_collection: Use a reviewer committee to screen blueprints before expanding them into multiturn tool interactions
verifier: Action consistency, tool execution, and reviewer filtering
main_limit: Simulated users and reviewers may share teacher bias, and domain rules remain shallow

name: TOUCAN
source_unit: Real MCP servers, tool schemas, and synthetic tasks
synthesis_or_collection: Expand multiturn tool trajectories from 495 servers and more than 2,000 tools
verifier: Schema, tool-execution, and trajectory-consistency filters
main_limit: Server availability, licenses, and security boundaries vary, while scale does not guarantee state-machine diversity

name: DIVE
source_unit: Evidence returned by real tool execution and tasks generated in reverse
synthesis_or_collection: Run tools first to obtain evidence, then derive tasks and trajectories entailed by that evidence
verifier: Execution evidence, task entailment, and structural-diversity filtering
main_limit: General tool evidence does not automatically supply institutional policies, permissions, or high-stakes consequences

name: AgentScaler
source_unit: Tool environments, general primitives, and domain tasks
synthesis_or_collection: Learn general agentic primitives before domain specialization
verifier: Executable environment rules and task-success checks
main_limit: The gap between synthetic environments and real business distributions still requires external schemas and expert calibration

name: EnvScaler
source_unit: Environment skeletons, topics, logical rules, and task scenarios
synthesis_or_collection: Programmatically generate environments, scenarios, and rule-verification functions
verifier: Per-scenario rule verifiers
main_limit: Model-generated rules may be internally consistent but unrealistic; complexity and business validity are different objectives

name: ASTRA
source_unit: Tool-call graphs, QA semantic topologies, and rule-based environments
synthesis_or_collection: Synthesize SFT trajectories from call graphs and executable RL arenas from semantic topologies
verifier: Tool execution, rule checks, and task-success functions
main_limit: Automated-verifier coverage and exploitability still require mutation testing and human sampling

name: AutoForge
source_unit: Tool documentation, simulated state, and user behavior
synthesis_or_collection: Generate difficult tasks, state machines, and verifiable environments from tool documentation
verifier: Programmatic rule verifiers and simulated-user constraints
main_limit: Tool documentation omits complete organizational processes, and simulated-user stability and external validity are limited

name: ToolBench / ToolLLM
source_unit: RapidAPI documentation, instructions, and tool trajectories
synthesis_or_collection: Generate single- and multi-tool instructions from API collections and route them with a teacher
verifier: Primarily API execution and model judging
main_limit: Teacher trajectories and API availability are noisy, with little domain state and weak terminal verification

name: ToolSandbox
source_unit: Simulated tools, user dialogues, initial states, and milestones
synthesis_or_collection: Manually design state dependencies, distracting tools, and multiturn tasks
verifier: Milestone similarity and final-state checks
main_limit: The tool world is simulated, industry rules are shallow, and the dataset is relatively small

name: AppWorld task packages
source_unit: Application APIs, resettable databases, tasks, and goal states
synthesis_or_collection: Construct a controllable application world before authoring or generating tasks and state tests
verifier: Target-state and collateral-damage tests
main_limit: Domain policy is limited, and simulated applications differ from production services in permissions and failure distributions
